command_reference.document: Foxconn T99W175 (Microsoft Generic Mobile Broadband Adapter) — Qualcomm SDX55 AT set observed via AT+CLAC

capabilities.notes: Foxconn/Microsoft SDX55 firmware exposes NO Quectel/Telit/Sierra engineering verbs (AT+QENG, AT#SERVINFO, AT^SCELLINFO, AT+XMCI, AT+CGED all ERROR — confirmed via AT+CLAC, 183 cmds). Cell visibility comes from the Qualcomm proprietary AT$QCRSRP? / AT$QCRSRQ? multi-cell reports (same parser as the Orbic RC400L path, parse_qcrsrp). AT+CESQ also ERRORs; use AT$QCSQ / AT+CSQ for signal. NR-capable (SDX55) but AT surfaces cells only on the serving RAT.

serving.notes: Qualcomm multi-cell RSRP report: repeated (pci,earfcn,rsrp_dbm) triplets, first is the serving cell. LTE-only field layout observed on T99W175.F0.1.0.0.9.GC.004. Same parser as the Orbic RC400L (parse_qcrsrp in capture_cell_at.c).

neighbor.notes: $QCRSRP? returns serving + neighbor cells in one report; the neighbor rows are the 2nd..Nth triplets. There is no separate neighbour-only verb on this firmware (AT+QENG="neighbourcell" ERRORs).

plmn_scan.notes: 3GPP operator scan. Returns operator names and RATs.

diag.port: QCDM/DM diagnostic on USB interface if00 (ttyUSB, driver=option; ttyUSB19 in the observed composition). capture_cell_diag auto-detects it by matching the IMEI from an AT probe on a sibling port; diagport=<path> overrides.
diag.notes: SDX55 5G NR SA/NSA (sub-6) — same silicon family as the Quectel RM500Q (2c7c:0800), so the full DIAG_TARGET_CODES set applies (capture_cell_diag/diag_config.c is the single source of truth): LTE ML1 serving 0xB193, LTE RRC OTA/SIB1 0xB0C0, LTE ML1 idle neighbors 0xB192, LTE ML1 connected neighbors 0xB195, LTE ML1 per-cell measurement 0xB17F (per-cell RSSI with RSRP/RSRQ), NR5G RRC OTA/SIB1 0xB821, NR5G ML1 measurement DB 0xB97F, GNSS 0x1476/0x14D8. interface=0 pins if00 (DIAG). SPC is not gated on SDX55 (drop --spc). diag_config_filter_supported narrows this intended set to the T99W175's advertised subset at handshake time, so the device decides what is actually subscribed. This part emits 0xB17F with version byte 5 across several firmware builds.
